status.en: 28 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 100% more than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Addis Ababa.
status.nb: 28 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 100 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Addis Ababa.

summary.en: Russian Su-35 fighter jets and S-400 air defence systems have arrived in Ethiopia as fighting spreads across Tigray, Amhara and Oromia, with drone strikes hitting an IDP camp in Amhara and a shelter in South Wollo, causing civilian casualties. Militant attackers killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians in Oromia, while drone strikes in Amhara killed 14, including children. Thousands of people are fleeing the border clashes, with about 50,000 refugees arriving in Moyale, Kenya. The conflict has also seen Ethiopia begin homegrown drone manufacturing. The UCDP recorded 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
